upstream.scope_note: The locker is committed as upstream collection but not consumed by canonical Evidence Integration; no retroactive sweep or accepted chronology inferred.

review_standard: Preserve the ordinary exact actor proposition and its original date; source-carrier publication is not independent corroboration. UNSUBSTANTIATED is not FALSE; FALSE is not evidence of knowing deception. Only evidenced actor-to-carrier/source-to-source edges may be proposed; no protected WOL edge without formal qualification.

candidate_findings.actor: Hassan Fadlallah, Hezbollah parliamentary bloc member
candidate_findings.original_reported_words: Explosives were 'intended exclusively for use against the Israeli occupation' in southern Lebanon; assassination allegations described as 'baseless' (AP Oct15 attribution, not authenticated primary Hezbollah transcript)
atomic_propositions: Hezbollah owned the seized 780 kg explosives shipment (affirmative acknowledgment)
Shipment was intended exclusively for attacks on Israeli forces in southern Lebanon (contested intent claim)
Domestic political-assassination allegations were baseless (categorical denial; underlying accusation also unproved)
documentary_record: AP Oct12 reported 780 kg seizure, two detained, and transport instructions without established end use
AP Oct15 records Fadlallah's Hezbollah ownership admission and asserted exclusive external-use intent
AP Oct30 reports military court charges against 13 (2 detained, 11 in absentia); charges include internal security and unlawful explosives but are not findings of assassination purpose or convictions
verified_relationships: Fadlallah Oct15 statement -> AP Oct15 REPORTS/QUOTES (speaker attribution)
AP Oct30 court report -> AP Oct15 earlier admission RETELLS as prior statement, NOT a new Oct30 Hezbollah repetition
Lebanese court charges -> intent proposition DOCUMENTARY_CONTEXT, NOT automatic CONTRADICTS or proven falsity
candidate_findings.truth: OWNERSHIP_ACKNOWLEDGED_BY_CLAIMANT and consistent with court-linked seizure; intended target and categorical denial UNSUBSTANTIATED, not FALSE
candidate_findings.knowledge: Hezbollah's ownership admission evidences its own knowledge of ownership as of Oct15; does not establish knowledge that its claimed destination was false
candidate_findings.repetition_vs_novel: New candidate family relative to 13-case packet, but October30 AP is a procedural update to earlier Oct15 original statement, not new speaker repetition; no denominator promotion
candidate_findings.missing: Original Hezbollah/Fadlallah release; Lebanese military court order and evidence on route, receiver and intended use; any subsequent correction, admission or verified operational instructions.

source_behavior_and_correction_review.no_proven_knowledge: No source-qualified knowledge-of-falsity finding for tanker tally, USV/drone claims, Saudi interceptions, Hezbollah intended use, or Trump forecast.
